services.value: Eurofins provides “analytical testing services” across multiple areas including “Life” (Food & Feed Testing, Environment Testing, Agro Testing, Sensory and Consumer Research), “BioPharma” (BioPharma Services, BioPharma Product Testing, Medical Device Services, Contract Development & Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO), and BioPharma Discovery Services & Products), and “Diagnostic Services & Products” including “In Vitro Diagnostics Solutions” and “Clinical Diagnostic Services.”
